Al Jazeera, 28 July 2026 — strikes, sanctions bill, drone figures:

Russian strikes & casualties: On Monday (27 July), Russian strikes in eastern Ukraine resulted in 7 deaths and over 20 injuries, according to officials. A Ukrainian drone strike on a commercial building in Russia's Belgorod region killed one person and wounded two others. Heaviest fighting concentrated in Ukraine's Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk areas within Donetsk region.

Senate sanctions bill: Imposes 100 percent tariffs on goods from the five largest importers of Russian oil and gas, including China and India. Trump sought last-minute additions of Iran sanctions to the same bill. Vote expected Tuesday, same day as Zelenskyy's White House meeting.

Drone production: Ukraine projects 6 to 7 million short-range attack drones this year. Pentagon's $1.1 billion program will have ordered "just under 200,000 drones cumulatively by February 2027." Two nations advancing toward a joint drone production agreement.

Related: Ukraine's ambassador stated the Iranian tanker attacked Saturday carried "drones and military components from Iran to Russia"; Iran threatened retaliation.
